The '''Duo blaster carbine''' was a dual-[[Barrel/Legends|barreled]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and sold for 1,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The barrels of the 2.5-[[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] weapon were positioned vertically with an upper and lower barrel. The weapon had a maximum range of 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and users could fire the barrels separately or together. The weapon lacked a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting and used [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] that cost 100 credits and held fifty shots.<ref name="UAA" />
